wistram_academy.name: Wistram Academy

canon_ref.note: Kent Scott says only Wistram could cast a spell that reaches across the world. Pisces and Ceria studied there (2.04).

wistram_academy.summary: The isle of mages. Its mages link stranded Earthers through their phones in a costly spell, and a gathering of great mages there ranks the world's likeliest disasters.

invrisil.name: Invrisil

canon_ref.note: Fals: three hundred miles north of Celum. That Magnolia's winter home (2.06) is in Invrisil is likely, not stated.

invrisil.summary: The city of adventurers, far north of Celum. Magnolia Reinhart winters there and travels to it in a horseless magic carriage.

tailless_thief.name: The Tailless Thief
tailless_thief.summary: The most famous and most expensive inn in Liscor, on the north side. Busy from morning, with bright lamps and Drake barmaids; almost all its guests are well-off Drakes.

stitchworks.name: Stitchworks
stitchworks.summary: Octavia's potion shop on a side street of Celum: herbs on the beams, potions on the walls, a safety lamp, and boards where the display glass should be.

boom_tree_forest.name: Boom-bark forest

canon_ref.note: A scouting party is said to have vanished here; patrols avoid it.

boom_tree_forest.summary: A stand of odd, bark-stripped trees south-east of Liscor. The bark explodes when heated, so it is avoided—until Erin has it harvested as tough, free timber for the new inn.

death_beyond_death.name: Death beyond death

canon_ref.note: Toren fell into liscor_dungeon near Liscor and emerged here days later: the same dungeon reaches this far. Not walkable from this end yet; a later book may open the path.

death_beyond_death.summary: A narrow, feared opening in a mountainside far north of Liscor, in Red Fang territory. Three Goblin tribes have died trying to clear whatever lives inside. Deep tunnels are thought to reach all the way to the ruins near Liscor.

gnoll_tavern.name: The Gnoll tavern

canon_ref.note: Non-chronological Interlude; exact name and street not given.

gnoll_tavern.summary: A Gnoll-run tavern in Liscor known for good food, where Krshia and Selys corner Erin about her love life.

goblin_mountain_lair.name: The mountain dungeon

canon_ref.note: No proper name given in the text; a golem-guarded ruin/dungeon in the mountains where Rags' tribe settles.

goblin_mountain_lair.summary: A golem-guarded ruin in the mountains where Rags' tribe kills an animated suit of armor, loses six goblins to a trap, and seals off a dangerous corridor to make the entrance their new lair.

jawbreaker_camp.name: Jawbreaker camp
jawbreaker_camp.summary: Camp of the small Jawbreaker Tribe, a tributary of the Red Fang. Rags ambushes and kills its Hob chief, Rockgaw, to fold the tribe into her own.

empire_of_sands.name: Empire of Sands

canon_ref.note: Never shown on-page; known only through its Emperor's declaration of war on Reim.

empire_of_sands.summary: A rising power of Chandrar, ruled by an unseen Emperor. Kills Flos Reimarch's ally Drevish and sends his head to Reim, starting a war.

rhir.name: Rhir

canon_ref.note: Named per the wider story's later canon, not stated in this chapter's text itself; flagged low-confidence until a later book confirms it on-page. A distant continent gripped by a war against Demons, expected to matter in later books.

rhir.summary: A war-torn continent far from Izril, where Demons press against a kingdom of the Blighted Lands. Unconnected to Liscor's story so far.

blighted_lands.name: The Blighted Lands
blighted_lands.summary: The border region of a small kingdom ruled by the Blighted King, Othius the Fourth, holding a wall against Demons beyond. Home to about twenty summoned Earther Heroes, including Tom.

red_fang_territory.name: The Red Fang's territory

canon_ref.note: No proper name given in the text; wild highland country north of Liscor's territory where the Red Fang, Gold Stone and other goblin tribes range, including the valley of Rags's final battle with Garen and the road she later raids.

red_fang_territory.summary: Wild, mountainous country north of Liscor's territory, home to the powerful Red Fang Tribe and its neighbors and vassals. Rags conquers it tribe by tribe here, ending with the Red Fang itself, and stays on to train and rearm her people.

stone_spears_camp.name: The Stone Spears camp

canon_ref.note: A sparse Gnoll mining camp near the Grisrith mountain range, south of the Blood Fields, per the text; its exact distance from Liscor is not given.

stone_spears_camp.summary: A sparse Gnoll mining camp in the northern mountains, home to the Stone Spears Tribe under Chieftain Urksh. Shelters an injured Ryoka, then is nearly destroyed by the Goblin Lord's army in a single night.

azkerash_castle.name: Az'kerash's castle

canon_ref.note: Hidden behind a living, illogical maze findable only with fae or similarly strange guidance. Its exact location is otherwise unstated beyond 'somewhere in the war-torn north', near the Zel/Ilvriss battlefield.

azkerash_castle.summary: A vast black-stone fortress hidden behind a magical, ever-shifting maze, home to the legendary Necromancer Az'kerash and his undead court. Found only by Ryoka, guided by the Frost Faeries, to deliver Teriarch's letter.

magnolia_estate.name: Magnolia Reinhart's estate
magnolia_estate.summary: Lady Magnolia Reinhart's vast, heavily-warded mansion outside Invrisil, guarded by golems and illusions. Shelters newly-arrived Earth-transplants and is where Erin plays chess with Magnolia and hears her fears of a coming war.

frenzied_hare.name: The Frenzied Hare
frenzied_hare.summary: A run-down inn in Celum kept by Agnes, a former [Tailor], while her husband and cook lies ill; Erin takes over its kitchen after Toren strands her.

baleros.name: Baleros

canon_ref.note: Stands in for Niers' war camp and tent; the battlefield against General Grimvol is not named.

baleros.summary: A hot, jungle-covered continent where armies are hired out to settle quarrels. Niers Astoragon camps there with his army and students on the eve of battle.

liscor_park.name: Liscor's park
liscor_park.summary: A big park in the middle of walled Liscor, with trees, grass and a towering wooden playground whose safety spells a Wistram mage renews every year.

giant_bee_cave.name: The giant bee cave

canon_ref.note: Its exact place is not given; one of several caves Toren had found.

giant_bee_cave.summary: A cave in the snowy land near Liscor holding a huge nest of hand-sized Ashfire Bees and their honey. Erin raids it with Toren on her first sledge trip.

north_of_the_high_passes.name: North of the High Passes

canon_ref.note: Distance to Celum is a guess; she walks under three hours before the wolves, then pushes the sledge for miles.

north_of_the_high_passes.summary: Flat, snowbound wild land just north of the High Passes, with woods, wolves and a hibernating bear, some hours from the road to Celum. Toren leaves Erin here.

zeres.name: Zeres
zeres.summary: A Drake Walled City whose ruler, the Serpentine Matriarch, sits among the lords who judge Zel Shivertail. Its [Dangersense] alarm is one of those reported to Niers.

drake_assembly_hall.name: The Drake assembly hall

canon_ref.note: Neither the room nor its city is named; the id is ours.

drake_assembly_hall.summary: A hall where rulers of the Drake cities lounge on long padded seats to hear and judge Zel Shivertail's account of his war with Ilvriss.
